title: Promote one leaf through eager and CUDA graph
objective: Verify that one leaf win survives the exact eager call and an independently captured CUDA-graph replay.
preconditions: Production graph bucket and static input contract
steps: Check graph outputs before timing and after recapture with a different seed
Measure paired eager and graph lanes
Record capture failures as unavailable rather than falling back to eager

acceptance.pass: Both production modes pass correctness and their paired speed gates.
acceptance.no_win: Either mode is neutral or slower.
acceptance.invalid: Graph capture failed or graph correctness was not checked.

stop_rule: An eager-only number is a probe, not a promotable leaf verdict.
origin_evidence: Several device-level wins disappeared once graph and dispatch boundaries were included.
